subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a metal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phosphorus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Phosphorus is a non-metal.**
 
• It is a chemical element with the symbol **P** and atomic number 15.
 
• Phosphorus exists in several forms, the most common being white and red phosphorus.
 
• It is essential for life, playing a key role in the formation of DNA, RNA, and ATP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Metals vs Non-metals:**

 
 
• Metals are typically malleable, ductile, and good conductors of heat and electricity.
 
• Non-metals, on the other hand, are usually brittle (if solid), and poor conductors of heat and electricity.
 
• Examples of metals include Aluminium, Mercury, and Sodium.
 
• Examples of non-metals include Phosphorus, Carbon, and Sulfur.
 
 
 
• **Types of Phosphorus:**
 
 
• **White Phosphorus:** Highly reactive and is used in military applications like incendiary bombs.
 
• **Red Phosphorus:** More stable and used in safety matches, fireworks, and pesticides.
 
 
 
• **Phosphorus in Biology:**
 
 
• Phosphorus is a key component of DNA and RNA, which are essential for genetic information transfer.
 
• It is also vital in the formation of ATP (adenosine triphosphate), the energy currency of cells.
 
• Phosphates are an important part of bones and teeth in the form of calcium phosphate.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Impact:**
 
 
• Excess phosphorus in water bodies can lead to eutrophication, causing algal blooms that deplete oxygen and harm aquatic life.
 
• Managing phosphorus levels in agriculture and waste management is crucial to prevent environmental degradation.
